correctness.rationale: Every zero/nonzero vertex-support stratum is disjoint and locally closed. Orthogonal-complement is an involution on P(W); projective choices on each bipartite connected component form P^1, whereas odd cycles force an etale isotropic fixed point. S_B×S_B is two disjoint copies of S_B even when nonsplit, so ([S_B]−1)^2=1. Frobenius acts with trace 1+ε^r; expansion gives q^j and εq^j factors and the finite zeta product. K_h induced support sizes 0,1,2 versus ≥3 yield exact A_h,C_h; nonsplit q^3 growth and split q^h growth for h≥4.
